name: create_rebar_group
author: hptekla
title: Create rebar group
description: Creates a group of reinforcing bars (e.g. stirrups, ties) hosted by a concrete member with target spacing and bar shape polygon.

fatherId.description: Identifier ID of the host concrete Part.

shapePoints.description: Polygon vertices [{x, y, z}] defining the bar cross-section curve.

startX.description: Distribution start X coordinate in mm.

startY.description: Distribution start Y coordinate in mm.

startZ.description: Distribution start Z coordinate in mm.

endX.description: Distribution end X coordinate in mm.

endY.description: Distribution end Y coordinate in mm.

endZ.description: Distribution end Z coordinate in mm.

spacing.description: Target spacing between bars in mm.
